title: A test whose two arms raise the same exception is kept when the arms come from two places in the source
summary: `if strict then raise Not_found else raise Not_found` is compiled to a test of `strict` and two copies of the raise, at every native level. Arms that are the same action are merged only when their debugging information is the same.
cause: `create_switch` in `middle_end/flambda2/simplify/expr_builder.ml` merges the arms through an `Apply_cont_expr.Set`, and `compare` in `terms/apply_cont_expr.ml` compares the debugging information, so the set has two elements.
reference: related: issue #6751, PR #6753 (identical arms not shared; not about debugging information)
